steps.action: Contact the user (out-of-band, e.g. phone) to verify if they initiated the login. Treat as compromised until confirmed otherwise.
If unconfirmed: lock the account and invalidate all active sessions immediately.
Review what the account did after login — file access, email, VPN, admin actions.
Check the login's source IP against threat intel. Geo-location check for unexpected country.
Force password reset + MFA re-enrollment. Audit recent activity for any persistence mechanisms.
Implement conditional access policies — block logins outside business hours or from unusual geographies by default.
Document the login event, verification outcome, and any downstream activity observed.
